To reduce the number of cycles waiting on L1TEX data accesses verify the memory access patterns are optimal for the target architecture, attempt to increase cache hit rates by increasing data locality (coalescing), or by changing the cache configuration. rule_message.message: If you execute __syncthreads() to synchronize the threads of a block, it is recommended to have at least two blocks per multiprocessor (compared to the currently executed 1.4 blocks) This way, blocks that aren't waiting for __syncthreads() can keep the hardware busy.
